svg.title: D1/D2: definition and composition
svg.desc: D1/D2: definition and composition. Modern D1/D2, progression 2016–2024 and absence 2016–2023: four descriptive contrasts per outcome, percentage points; full D2 uses a nominal 98.75% interval and the other three use 95%, all clustered by school. Full D2, common-sample D2, common-sample D1 and full D1 separate composition from definition. Progression decomposition: −0.02 + +0.00 + −3.08 = −3.10 pp; absence: −0.02 + +0.00 + −0.79 = −0.81 pp. Sums use unrounded values; displayed hundredths may differ. Historical 2005–2015 D1 and D2 classify the same events, so there is no discriminating contrast or plotted point. Common and full samples differ; point differences have no joint interval and are not interpreted as causal effects.
